description.en-US: Precise edits: string replace / line range / unified diff, all undoable via backup
description.zh-CN: 精确代码编辑：字符串替换 / 行区间替换 / unified diff，全部带备份可撤销

tools.description: Replace a string in a text file (the file must exist). PREFERRED editing tool for most edits: copy old_string character-for-character from fs_read output; fall back to edit_diff only for structural changes across many places, edit_lines only with known line numbers. Args: path (absolute), old_string (must match exactly once unless replace_all), new_string, replace_all (bool, default false), expected_revision (the `revision` from fs_read or from the previous edit's result — the call is rejected with a stale-observation error if the file changed since you observed it; re-read and rebuild). If the exact match fails, a tolerant pass retries ignoring line-ending (CRLF/LF), trailing-whitespace and BOM differences — the result reports match_type so you can tell; uniqueness is always enforced (multi-match errors list candidate lines). The original file is backed up automatically; the result carries {path, bytes, edits, match_type, byte_range, backup, revision} — pass that `revision` to your next edit of this file, and the output to fs_restore to undo.
tools.name: edit_replace

expected_revision.description: revision from fs_read or the previous edit's result; rejected if stale

path.description: absolute file path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots)

tools.description: Replace a 1-based inclusive line range in a text file (the file must exist). Args: path (absolute), start_line, end_line, content (new text for the range; empty content deletes it), expected_revision (the `revision` from fs_read or from the previous edit's result; stale observations are rejected — re-read and rebuild). The original file is backed up automatically; the result carries {path, bytes, replaced, backup, revision} for fs_restore to undo and for your next edit of this file.
tools.name: edit_lines

content.description: new text for the range; empty string deletes

expected_revision.description: revision from fs_read or the previous edit's result; rejected if stale

path.description: absolute file path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots)

tools.description: Apply a unified diff to a text file (the file must exist). Prefer edit_replace for most edits; use this only for structural changes across many places. Args: path (absolute), patch (unified diff text with @@ hunks), expected_revision (the `revision` from fs_read or from the previous edit's result; stale observations are rejected — re-read and rebuild). Context lines must match exactly — no fuzz; on mismatch the tool errors and the file is untouched. The original file is backed up automatically; the result carries {path, bytes, hunks_applied, backup, revision} for fs_restore to undo and for your next edit of this file.
tools.name: edit_diff

expected_revision.description: revision from fs_read or the previous edit's result; rejected if stale

path.description: absolute file path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots)
